title: Five-term external-cup homology ladder for a short exact left coefficient sequence
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and let $0\to F\to E\to Q\to0$ be a specified short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module. For each $M\in\{F,E,Q\}$ put $A_M=\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(f,M)\otimes_k\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(g,G))$ and $B_M=\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(f\circ\operatorname{pr}_1,\operatorname{pr}_1^*M\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)$, using [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model] and [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. Specify normalized cochain maps $c_M:A_M\to B_M$ in the sense of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. For every $n\in\mathbb N$ there exist two five-term rows $R_1,R_2$ of $k$-modules, exact at their three interior terms, a commutative diagram $\phi:R_1\to R_2$, and isomorphisms $e_1:(R_1)_2\cong H^n(A_F)$ and $e_2:(R_2)_2\cong H^n(B_F)$ such that $e_2\circ\phi_2=H^n(c_F)\circ e_1$. If $H^r(c_E)$ is invertible for every natural $r$, then $\phi_0$ and $\phi_3$ are invertible; if $H^r(c_Q)$ is invertible for every natural $r$, then $\phi_1$ and $\phi_4$ are invertible. This constructs the ladder, without assuming acyclicity, a cohomological bound, or invertibility of the central comparison.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, paragraph beginning Consider a short exact sequence, after equation-kunneth-on-cech (equation 33.29.1.1). Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED.

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-picard-external-cup-left-comparison-complexes to the coefficient sequence S and G. Obtain normalized maps d1,d2,d3, short exact sequences A and B of complexes, their short-complex morphism psi, vanishing negative middle and quotient terms, and scalar-model comparison isomorphisms in every natural degree. No five-term ladder is assumed.

Prove normalized_homology_eq: the homology maps of any two normalized external-cup cochain maps agree in natural degree n. Apply tensor_kunneth_nat to the two scalar models, using picardScalarModel_negative for nonnegative support. Precompose both maps with its linear equivalence. On each direct-sum summand, pure tensors span; lift the two factor homology elements to cycles via the surjective homology projections. The cycle formula provides z, and both normalizations give exactly the same externalCup expression. Injectivity of picardScalarModelEquiv implies equality on z. DirectSum.linearMap_ext and tensor extensionality prove equality of maps. Replace the maps d1,d2,d3 in the three comparison squares by the specified c,cE,cQ.

Take the six-term homology sequences of A and B at integer degrees i=n-1 and j=n. Their first term is H^i of the first coefficient; delete this term using ComposableArrows.delta-zero. Mathlib composableArrows5_exact gives exactness of both resulting five-term rows. Map them with delta-zero applied to mapComposableArrows5; its connecting square is delta_naturality. The middle objects are H^n(A.X1) and H^n(B.X1). Use the comparison isomorphisms and normalized_homology_eq to obtain the required central equality.

For each natural r the comparison-square equality u followed by b equals a followed by H(cE), or H(cQ), transfers invertibility of H(cE) or H(cQ) to u by isIso_comp_right_iff. This proves invertibility of the current-degree outside arrows. When n is a successor, the preceding degree n-1 is natural, and the same proof gives the other two arrows. When n=0 the preceding degree is -1: homology is zero because the complex term is zero. IsZero.isIso proves any arrow between the two zero homology objects invertible. Combine the two separate outer-invertibility implications with the exact rows and central equality. No five lemma or central invertibility is used.

proof_origin.place: C4: Tag 0BED short-exact cochain diagram, isolated in the comparison-complex construction; explicit normalization uniqueness, Mathlib long-exact homology naturality, and outer-invertibility transfer in the delivered Lean proof.

lean.statement:
theorem picardExternalCupCochain_left_homology_ladder
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (cE : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₂ G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₂ G))
    (hcE : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₂ G cE)
    (cQ : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₃ G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₃ G))
    (hcQ : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₃ G cQ)
    (c : picardExternalTotal f g S.X₁ G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₁ G))
    (hc : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g S.X₁ G c) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (R₁ R₂ : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{w} k) 4) (φ : R₁ ⟶ R₂)
      (e₁ : R₁.obj' 2 ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g S.X₁ G).homology (n : ℤ))
      (e₂ : R₂.obj' 2 ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g S.X₁ G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
      R₁.Exact ∧ R₂.Exact ∧
      ((∀ r : ℕ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap cE (r : ℤ))) →
        IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 0) ∧ IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 3)) ∧
      ((∀ r : ℕ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap cQ (r : ℤ))) →
        IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 1) ∧ IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 4)) ∧
      ComposableArrows.app' φ 2 ≫ e₂.hom =
        e₁.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c (n : ℤ)
